governance.new_component_rule: Reuse Canonical before creating; a new component needs Purpose/Context/Data dependency/Interaction/States/Responsive/A11y/Engineering contract.
governance.duplication: CONTROLLED — one canonical primitive per job; domain differences are Variants, never forks.
governance.naming: semantic lum-* names; no color/number in name; currentColor icons.

members.name: lum-btn
members.notes: specificity lifted to .lum-app .lum-btn to beat button{color:inherit}; active scale .965; touch >=44px

members.name: lum-iconbtn
members.notes: ghost, no border box; bell badge-dot removed
